BehaviorTree.ID: Calibrate Scene Camera From Shelf Board
BehaviorTree._description: Calibrates the fixed scene D415 from the shelf-mounted ChArUco board. Loads the shelf-board pose estimated by Calibrate Wrist Orbbec On Shelf Board, moves the arm to a saved clear-view waypoint, then averages scene-camera detections with Calibrate Fixed Camera From Known Board. Saves only a candidate scene_camera_link pose. The 2F robot model must already be running with a provisional scene_camera_link-to-optical-frame transform so the helper can resolve the camera's internal TF. Keep the board fully visible in every sample because the helper may reuse the previous detection after a missed frame.

SubTree.ID: Calibrate Fixed Camera From Known Board
